notes: Phase order: SKILL.md puts the literature check after the five reports are drafted, but a single sequential run had already read the whole paper; I ran the searches before writing the reports and kept the addendum confined to R2. Several Bash calls were blocked by the harness when they used shell variables or brace expansion, so literal paths were needed. related_search.py queries sometimes printed nothing with no stated refusal reason, making the 12-query budget accounting unclear. The pool-position band for R3 (66) fell above its composite band (61.5) with no script warning, and the rule that Overall 4 needs pool >= 65 and dimensions mostly >= 60 conflicts slightly with the composite-to-band mapping (60-69 = Overall 4 but the pool bands start 62). The ICLR label '4 on {0,2,4,6,8,10}' for a final Overall of 3 reads confusingly next to the internal 1-6 scale. The EIC section asks for a 600-1000 word meta-review excluding tables; mine is within that range.
